title: Part receipts
description: parts/<part>/receipts.json in the work folder (ADR-0019, E5b): the append-only record of what happened to one part, written only by `harness part receipt`, modelled on `spec-receipt`. Receipts are numbered 1, 2, ... in the order written. A receipt binds a kind (`checked`, `reviewed`, `locked`, `reopened`) to the part hash at that time; the part's status is derived from the latest receipts and the current hash (`part_receipts.part_status`), never stored. A hash is evidence that the part is unchanged since the receipt, not who wrote it.

part.description: The part the file belongs to: the folder name under parts/.

receipts.description: Oldest first. The latest receipt is the last element.

n.description: 1 for the first receipt, then one more each (append-only).

kind.description: checked: `part check` passed on part_hash. reviewed: a review round of the part at part_hash ended with `review.verdict`. locked: the part is closed at part_hash, over `inputs`. reopened: a locked part is open again.

part_hash.description: The part hash (`part_receipts.part_hash`) when the receipt was written.

at.description: UTC time, second precision. Information only, never an expiry.

tool_version.description: Package version of tekla_harness that wrote the receipt.

file.description: Work-relative path of the review file, parts/<part>/review/round-<round>/review.md.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the review file's bytes when the receipt was written.

review.description: Required (not null) for kind `reviewed`; null for the others.

reason.description: Required (not null) for kind `reopened`: why the part is open again; null for the others.

inputs.description: Required (not null) for kind `locked`: the part hash of each input part (manifest `inputs`) when the lock was written; {} for a part without inputs. Null for the others.
